text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Last time my best efforts fell 
short, and I was too ashamed to show my 
face to Lady Shiraoki, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Even the Buddha loses patience after three 
strikes! If I lose again, who knows what 
kind of divine punishment awaits me...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So this time for sure! I did the 
hundred-shrine visit, pointed my pillow in 
a lucky direction, and even kept drawing 
fortunes until I got Great Blessing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
With sheer confidence and sheer luck, I'm 
gonna win~~!!
